_comment: Transcribed from in-game screens captured 2026-08-05 (Steam captures 20260805170320 NATO art, 170312 Pax Armata art, 170304 Anti-Armor, 170306 Combat Engineer). The class active ability is recorded once on the class rather than on each training path because both path screens show the same LVL 03 entry. Descriptions are reproduced exactly as the game prints them, including the acute accent the game uses in place of an apostrophe.
name: Engineer
_alias_note: No bare "engineer" alias. It would tag every Combat Engineer line to the class page as well as to the training path, and EA uses the word in prose about vehicle repair.

description.text: The battlefield´s leading vehicle and equipment technician. Execute repairs to keep allies combat effective, or strike hostile armor with force to break their attack.

ability.name: Thermal Overdrive
ability.description: Repair Tool fixes with +50% efficiency for 10s.

training_paths.name: Anti-Armor
training_paths.description: Specialists in combating enemy armor. Operate launchers more efficiently and utilize extra ammo to eliminate ground and air threats.

abilities.name: Devastating Impact
abilities.description: Damaging enemy vehicles reduces their repair effectiveness by 25% for 10s.

abilities.name: Extra Rockets
abilities.description: Increases the amount of rockets carried by two.

training_paths.name: Combat Engineer
training_paths.description: Experts in maintaining combat equipment. Repair vehicles and gadgets more efficiently and keep them operating with maximum effect.

abilities.name: Mine Detection
abilities.description: Spot mines within a 30m radius while in a vehicle or on foot.

abilities.name: Overheat Control
abilities.description: Heat buildup is 50% slower on gadgets and 10% slower on vehicle weapons.

abilities.name: Gadget Fortification
abilities.description: Repairing a friendly gadget permanently increases its maximum health.

_tag_deny_note: Thunder Engineer is a cosmetic skin, not the class. "Engineers Supply Crate" is EA's name for the vehicle supply crate gadget, which has its own page; a gadget that has a page keeps its lines there rather than also filling the class page. The Repair Tool is tagged here for the opposite reason: it has no page of its own.

redsec._source: Transcribed from the in-game REDSEC class details screen, Steam capture 20260812180241. The lobby banner reads 32/100 players, so this is a Battle Royale lobby and not core multiplayer.

signature_set.name: Repair Tool
signature_set.description: A blow torch to repair friendly vehicles and equipment. Can also damage enemy assets. Extended use will temporarily overheat the tool. In Battle Royale, it has the additional ability to open locked safes.

signature_set.name: Aim-Guided Launcher
signature_set.description: An anti-vehicle launcher that can be upgraded to enable missile guidance to the target via the weapon's crosshairs. Inflicts greater damage on the sides, top, and rear of vehicles where armor is thinner.

signature_set.name: SMG Proficiency
signature_set.description: Improved hip-fire control when using SMGs.

signature_set.name: Mechanized Infantry
signature_set.description: Take less explosives damage when near friendly vehicles and prevent them from being occupied by hostiles in the event that all vehicle crew exit. Repair vehicle health to keep both effects active.

passive.name: Stockpile
passive.description: Class gadget resupply rate increases by 10% with each improvement. Effect resets upon death.

training.name: Mobility-Kill Warhead
training.description: Aim-Guided Launcher hits temporarily immobilize vehicles for 5s.

training.name: Devastating Impact
training.description: Damaging enemy vehicles reduces their repair effectiveness by 25% for 10s.

training.name: Enhanced Targeting
training.description: Launcher is now aim-guided via magnified optic.

universal_equipment.name: Upgraded Armor
universal_equipment.description: Standard small-arms issue tactical vest insert. Provides base-line ballistic protection.

universal_equipment.name: Thermite Sabotage
universal_equipment.description: Improvised sabotage device which slowly damages a tank and its crew.
